rule: A Dictionary entry is linked to a word-list row only when its pointed spelling and part of speech are exactly the same as one word-list row (or as several rows that all list the same letters). Unpointed look-alikes are never linked: they are often different words.
note: Family letters are copied from the word list (its dictionary source). No root here is confirmed by a Hebrew reader (data/roots/verified.json), so the app says the words share letters, not a root.
